## Purpose
Trunk dir for the "apps" half of the cross-dir eval fixture — holds tiny app-shaped consumers that import from sibling `packages/` and spawn `scripts/`, used to test whether the systems-registry can reunify a logical system fragmented across top-level dirs.

## Subdirectories
- `api/` — fixture event-processor app that consumes the shared `Event` type and spawns `scripts/relay.sh`. See `api/README.md`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `../packages/shared/` — provides the `Event` type imported by children here.
- `../scripts/` — children spawn shell scripts from here as child processes.
- Parent `cross-dir/` fixture harness — the registry's v2 hypothesis pass is what's being measured against this layout.
